dish.title: Pressure-Cooker Butter Chicken
dish.description: Tender chicken thigh pieces in a silky, gently spiced tomato-butter-cream sauce made in an electric pressure cooker: onion, garlic, and ginger bloomed in butter with garam masala and paprika, pressure-cooked with tomato puree, then finished with cream and a last knob of butter. Served with fluffy basmati rice and cilantro.

recipe_version.title: Pressure-Cooker Butter Chicken
recipe_version.description: Tender chicken thigh pieces in a silky, gently spiced tomato-butter-cream sauce made in an electric pressure cooker: onion, garlic, and ginger bloomed in butter with garam masala and paprika, pressure-cooked with tomato puree, then finished with cream and a last knob of butter. Served with fluffy basmati rice and cilantro.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: divided: 1 1/2 tsp chicken, 1/2 tsp onion, 1/2 tsp rice water

ingredients.name: garam masala
ingredients.note: Store-bought ground spice blend (no allergens). Divided: 1 tsp chicken, 1 tsp spice mix, 1/2 tsp finish.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.note: Milk. Divided: 3 tbsp to sauté, 2 tbsp cold, cubed, to finish.

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: with the butter so it does not brown too fast

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: divided: 1/2 cup to deglaze the cooker, 2 1/4 cups for the rice

ingredients.name: heavy cream
ingredients.note: Milk. 2 tbsp held back for the finishing swirl.

ingredients.name: basmati rice
ingredients.preparation: rinsed until the water runs mostly clear

steps.title: Season the chicken and prep
steps.body: Cut the chicken into 1 1/2-inch pieces and toss with 1 1/2 tsp kosher salt and 1 tsp garam masala. Finely chop the onion, mince the garlic, and grate the ginger. In a small bowl combine 1 tsp garam masala, the cumin, coriander, turmeric, paprika, and cayenne. Rinse the basmati until the water runs mostly clear and drain. Cut 2 tbsp of the butter into cubes and keep cold. About 15 minutes.

steps.title: Sauté the aromatics
steps.body: Set a 6-quart electric pressure cooker to Sauté (high). Add 3 tbsp butter and the 1 tbsp oil; when the butter foams (about 2 minutes), add the onion and 1/2 tsp kosher salt. Cook, stirring, until soft and golden at the edges, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger and stir 1 minute. About 8 minutes.

steps.title: Bloom the spices and deglaze
steps.body: Add the spice mix and stir 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in 1/2 cup water and scrape the bottom thoroughly until nothing is stuck; this prevents a burn warning. Turn off Sauté. About 2 minutes.

steps.title: Layer and pressure cook
steps.body: Spread the chicken in an even layer over the onions. Pour the tomato puree over the top and do not stir (the thick tomato stays off the bottom). Lock the lid, set the valve to Sealing, and Pressure Cook on High for 5 minutes. It takes about 10 minutes to come to pressure. When the cook time ends, let the pressure release naturally for 5 minutes, then quick-release the rest. About 20 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: As soon as the cooker is sealed, combine the rinsed basmati, 2 1/4 cups water, and 1/2 tsp kosher salt in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce to low, and cook 15 minutes. Turn off the heat and let it stand covered 5 minutes, then fluff. This runs entirely inside the 20-minute pressure step and adds no time.

steps.title: Finish the sauce
steps.body: Open the lid away from you. Set to Sauté. Stir in all but 2 tbsp of the cream, the sugar, and the last 1/2 tsp garam masala. Simmer, stirring gently, 3 to 4 minutes, until the sauce thickens enough to coat a spoon and the chicken is very tender (at least 165 F; thighs are best at 175 F). Turn off the heat and stir in the 2 tbsp cold cubed butter until the sauce turns glossy. Taste and adjust salt. About 5 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon rice into one side of 4 wide, shallow bowls and ladle the butter chicken beside it. Drizzle the reserved 2 tbsp cream over the sauce in a loose swirl and scatter cilantro. About 2 minutes. kitchen_tested is false.

recipe_version.time_clock: Prep 15. Cook 37 = 8 sauté + 2 bloom/deglaze + 20 pressure (about 10 to come to pressure + 5 at High + 5 natural release) + 5 finish + 2 serve. Rice (15 cook + 5 rest) runs inside the 20-minute pressure step. Come-up time is counted, not hidden.
recipe_version.heat: Electric pressure cooker: Sauté (high) for butter and aromatics; Pressure Cook High 5 minutes with 5-minute natural release; Sauté to finish with cream. Stovetop saucepan for rice: boil, then low. No oven.
recipe_version.doneness: Chicken very tender, at least 165 F (175 F ideal for thighs); sauce thick enough to coat a spoon, glossy after the cold butter; no raw spice taste. Rice tender and fluffy with separate grains. kitchen_tested is false.

dietary_eligibility.nut_policy_note: No peanuts, tree nuts, or cashews. Many butter chicken recipes thicken with cashew paste; this one does not — the sauce is thickened by reduction, cream, and butter.

curator_preflight.detail: Every listed ingredient is used: seasoning/prep in step 1, aromatics in step 2, spice mix and deglaze in step 3, chicken and tomato in step 4, rice in step 5, cream/sugar/garam masala/cold butter in step 6, cream swirl and cilantro in step 7. Salt 1 1/2 + 1/2 + 1/2 tsp; garam masala 1 + 1 + 1/2 tsp; butter 3 + 2 tbsp; water 1/2 + 2 1/4 cups; cream 10 tbsp + 2 tbsp swirl.
3 tbsp butter + 1 tbsp oil to sauté; 2 tbsp cold butter to finish. Heavy cream in the sauce.
Garam masala is a declared store-bought spice blend. Sauce built in the cooker; no jarred simmer sauce.
Prep 15 + cook 37 (8 + 2 + 20 + 5 + 2) = 52. Pressure come-up (~10) and 5-minute natural release are inside the 20. Rice runs inside the pressure step.
Minimum-liquid rule stated; 1 serving not recommended in a 6-quart cooker.

scaling_notes.1: A true single serving is not recommended in a 6-quart cooker (minimum liquid and burn risk). For 1, make the 2-serving half batch below (1-serving shopping ratio 0.5) and refrigerate the second portion up to 3 days.
scaling_notes.2: Halve everything; keep the 1/2 cup deglazing water unchanged (minimum liquid). Same 5-minute High pressure; come-up is a few minutes faster. Rice: 3/4 cup basmati, 1 1/8 cups water.
do_not_scale: do not stir the tomato into the bottom before pressure cooking
5 minutes High + 5 minutes natural release (piece size, not batch size, sets the time)
